tool.name: GeneFior-Recompute
tool.description: Recalculate detection statistics from existing GeneFíor results
tool.command:
mkdir -p input_dir/raw_outputs output_dir &&
#if $sec_raw_outputs.diamond_results: ln -s '$sec_raw_outputs.diamond_results' 'input_dir/raw_outputs/user-provided-db_diamond_results.tsv' && #end if #if $sec_raw_outputs.blastn_results: ln -s '$sec_raw_outputs.blastn_results' 'input_dir/raw_outputs/user-provided-db_blastn_results.tsv' && #end if #if $sec_raw_outputs.blastx_results: ln -s '$sec_raw_outputs.blastx_results' 'input_dir/raw_outputs/user-provided-db_blastx_results.tsv' && #end if #if $sec_raw_outputs.blastp_results: ln -s '$sec_raw_outputs.blastp_results' 'input_dir/raw_outputs/user-provided-db_blastp_results.tsv' && #end if #if $sec_raw_outputs.bowtie2_results: ln -s '$sec_raw_outputs.bowtie2_results' 'input_dir/raw_outputs/user-provided-db_bowtie2_results_sorted.bam' && #end if #if $sec_raw_outputs.bwa_results: ln -s '$sec_raw_outputs.bwa_results' 'input_dir/raw_outputs/user-provided-db_bwa_results_sorted.bam' && #end if #if $sec_raw_outputs.minimap2_results: ln -s '$sec_raw_outputs.minimap2_results' 'input_dir/raw_outputs/user-provided-db_minimap2_results_sorted.bam' && #end if #if $sec_raw_outputs.run_parameters: ln -s '$sec_raw_outputs.run_parameters' 'input_dir/run_parameters.json' && #end if
GeneFior-recompute -i input_dir -o output_dir
#if $tools: --tools #echo ' '.join($tools)# #end if
--q-min-cov $sec_thresholds.q_min_cov --q-min-id $sec_thresholds.q_min_id --d-min-cov $sec_thresholds.d_min_cov --d-min-id $sec_thresholds.d_min_id --d-min-depth $sec_thresholds.d_min_depth --d-min-reads $sec_thresholds.d_min_reads --detection-system '$sec_thresholds.detection_system'
#if str($sec_thresholds.report_fasta): --report-fasta '$sec_thresholds.report_fasta' #end if
#if str($sec_thresholds.report_read_names): --report-read-names '$sec_thresholds.report_read_names' #end if
#if $query_fasta: --query-fasta '$query_fasta' #end if
#if str($sec_advanced.evalue): --evalue $sec_advanced.evalue #end if
$sec_advanced.allow_incomplete_relaxation $sec_advanced.verbose
&& cd output_dir && det=\$(find . -name '*_detection_matrix.tsv' | head -1) && mv "\$det" '$recomputed_detection_matrix' && evi=\$(find . -name '*_evidence_matrix.tsv' | head -1) && mv "\$evi" '$recomputed_evidence_matrix' && cd .. && zip -r '$results_archive' output_dir

param.name: run_parameters
param.label: Run parameters JSON
param.help: The run_parameters.json from the original GeneFíor run (optional, but recommended for inheriting source thresholds)

param.name: diamond_results
param.label: DIAMOND results TSV
param.help: DIAMOND results TSV file from the original run

param.name: blastn_results
param.label: BLASTn results TSV
param.help: BLASTn results TSV file from the original run

param.name: blastx_results
param.label: BLASTx results TSV
param.help: BLASTx results TSV file from the original run

param.name: blastp_results
param.label: BLASTp results TSV
param.help: BLASTp results TSV file from the original run

param.name: bowtie2_results
param.label: Bowtie2 sorted BAM
param.help: Bowtie2 sorted BAM file from the original run

param.name: bwa_results
param.label: BWA sorted BAM
param.help: BWA sorted BAM file from the original run

param.name: minimap2_results
param.label: Minimap2 sorted BAM
param.help: Minimap2 sorted BAM file from the original run

param.name: query_fasta
param.label: Query FASTA (for FASTA reporting)
param.help: Original query file used for alignment. Required when --report-fasta is used with BLAST/DIAMOND outputs

param.label: Report FASTA
param.help: Output sequences that mapped to genes

param.label: Report read names
param.help: Write deduplicated read-name files per database/tool/gene

param.name: evalue
param.label: E-value threshold
param.help: Optional e-value threshold to apply when recomputing

param.name: allow_incomplete_relaxation
param.label: Allow incomplete relaxation
param.help: Allow thresholds that are more permissive than the source run, acknowledging that previously discarded hits cannot be recovered

tool.help:
@GENEFIOR_HELP@
**GeneFior-Recompute** — Recalculate detection statistics
This tool recalculates detection statistics from existing sequence search outputs with different thresholds without needing to rerun the entire analysis. Provide the raw alignment output files (BLAST/DIAMOND TSVs and/or sorted BAM files) from a prior GeneFíor or AMRfior run.
**Important:** Query-level thresholds can be tightened safely. Relaxing them below the source run is rejected because source BLAST/DIAMOND outputs were already filtered. Use the "Allow incomplete relaxation" option to explicitly accept incomplete results.
**Outputs:**
- **Detection matrix** — Recomputed binary presence/absence per gene and tool - **Evidence matrix** — Recomputed qualified per-tool evidence statuses - **Results archive** — Full recomputed output directory (zip)
